description: Liquidation cascade history: past clustered same-side flush events reconstructed from our own tape, with start and end, prints, USD total and peak print, up to 72h back. /api/cascade tells you what is happening NOW; this tells you what already happened. Costs 0.03 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana or Base).

gap_s.description: max gap seconds within an event, default 60

min_usd.description: min event USD, default 100k (250k for scope=all)

scope.description: symbol = just this symbol (default), all = every recorded USDT perp

symbol.description: USDT perp symbol e.g. SOLUSDT, BTCUSDT (default SOLUSDT)

name: get_cascade_history

data.description: the get_cascade_history payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_cascade_history

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Cascade history
